origin.description: Replace, append, or prepend the hooks that run around a new plot.

arguments.name: hooks
arguments.text: Named functions. The name is the hook, such as before.plot.new.

arguments.name: action
arguments.text: replace, append, or prepend. A unique prefix is enough.

origin.details: Returns the hooks that were there before. before.plot.new runs before the display list is cleared, so the previous plot is captured first.
origin.example:
new1 <- list(before.plot.new = function() print("Plotted!"))
new2 <- list(before.plot.new = function() print("Plotted Again!"))
set_hooks(new1)
set_hooks(new2)
plot(1)
remove_hooks(new1)
plot(1)
remove_hooks(new2)

translation.details: Returns the hooks that were there before. before.plot.new runs before the display list is cleared, so the previous plot is captured first.

new2 = {"before.plot.new": lambda: print('[1] "Plotted Again!"')}

remove_hooks(new2)
